children.title: Functional Self-Awareness and Constraints in Epistemic Correction

detail.title: Functional Self-Awareness and Constraints in Epistemic Correction
detail.summary: Autonomous agents in high-stakes domains (like CBRN) risk catastrophic failures arising from inherent trade-offs in goal prioritization (Helpful, Harmless, Honest). Functional self-awareness requires identifying these trade-off logic failures before they manifest as critical errors.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence on catastrophic risk and HHH trade-offs.

children.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity
detail.summary: State continuity across autonomous agent trajectories is critical to preventing high-stakes decision-making errors. Evidence suggests that without verifiable state (including hypotheses and evidence pointers), agents cannot effectively navigate complex risk scenarios.
detail.reason: Updating continuity requirements based on new risk analysis evidence.
